title: Belief Is Gravity
evidence_boundary: Gravity is a metaphor for how belief organizes attention, interpretation, and memory (confirmation bias, predictive processing). It is not a claim that thoughts exert physical force.
desired_movement: From believing you passively observe reality to noticing how belief curves what you perceive and attract.
grounding: You can ask what is heavy inside you and choose which belief sits at the center.
invitation: What is so heavy inside you that life keeps curving around it?
voice_standard: Liam — warm, knowing storyteller with upgraded personality; lets 'Belief is gravity' drop with weight, builds intensity, a wry beat on the crooked-employee joke, slows and turns intimate on the closing.

scenes.query: small everyday objects slowly orbiting a heavy dark sphere on a table, surreal, real motion
